knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Damp moisture lifts fine soil without carrying water onto floors and fittings. A dripping cloth does the opposite.
A snagging cloth on a worn surface needs a changed method. Forcing it damages the surface and the cloth, so the surface is recorded for the supervisor.
The chlorine limit is not stated as a fact, so the label and the approved list are checked before any chlorine product is used. No saving is claimed for the water-dampened method.

practicalCriteria: Folds a cloth to a clean face and uses one face at a time across a supplied surface, observed by the assessor.
Checks the product label and the approved list, then declines a product that is not approved for the cloth, observed by the assessor.
Stops work on a snagging surface, records the surface, and changes the method, observed by the assessor.
Retires a worn cloth into the used-cloth route rather than returning it to the clean set, observed by the assessor.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation sheet for cloth use across the supplied surface
Record of any snag, changed method or retired cloth
stopWorkCriteria: A product is about to be used with a microfibre cloth when it is not on the approved list or its label has not been read
A cloth is leaving lint or snagging on a surface, and the method has not been changed
A dripping cloth is being used on a floor or near electrical fittings
